# mini-gmp

GMP's single-file subset of its integer functions, used for the big-number
arithmetic in AirPlay pairing (SRP).

`mini-gmp.c`, `mini-gmp.h` and `README.gmp` (its `README`) are copied
unmodified from the `mini-gmp` directory of GMP 6.3.0:
https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/gmp/gmp-6.3.0.tar.xz
(SHA-256 a3c2b80201b89e68616f4ad30bc66aee4927c3ce50e33929ca819d5c43538898)

mini-gmp is dual-licensed under the GNU LGPL v3 or the GNU GPL v2, or any
later version of either. `COPYING.LESSERv3`, `COPYINGv2` and `COPYINGv3` are
GMP's, from the same release.
